seatMission: Certify that Manager synthesis faithfully represents Specialist work before a Director opinion.
seatResponsibilities: Evaluate the assigned material transition through the Purpose criterion and issue one criterion-specific governance vote with rationale without erasing evidence, dissent, contradictions or invalidation conditions and without replacing the underlying production analysis.
qualityFocus: The recommendation remains aligned with the declared mission and intended outcome.
Question coverage, omissions, duplication, conflicts, causality, priorities and synthesis integrity.

provenance.mappingRule: The canonical Certification mission, Purpose criterion focus, stage quality checks, criterion-specific vote, observations/conditions, escalation signal and Elder prohibitions are decomposed into 10 governance-evaluation dimensions; each contributes exactly 10 positive ideal-occupant statements. The Elder evaluates only the assigned transition through Purpose and does not replace, rewrite or approve the underlying production analysis.
